description: Differential input held at exactly zero (inside dif_band) with vhyst=0: every clocked decision is digitally UNKNOWN and the contract maps it deterministically to the LOW decision; out must remain at vlo through multiple clock edges.
dut: X1 inp inn clk out 0 bhv_comparator_clocked_v1 td=2n tedge=1n

relations.derivation: out_undef maps UNKNOWN to vlo=0 on both the output and hysteresis-feedback DACs; without that mapping the midpoint 0.5 V would appear here.
